- Test image: extreme close-up (macro) of reddish-brown/orange dead tissue with black spiny bristle-like structures protruding upward

- Tar spot reference: smooth rounded black spots on green tissue — doesn't match
- Common rust reference: oval orange pustules — doesn't match
- Anthracnose stem reference: reddish-brown dead tissue with black discoloration — background color and tissue texture are consistent
- The spiny/bristly black structures are the defining diagnostic feature of Anthracnose leaf spot/top dieback
